title: Graphs with three eigenvalues from group divisible designs
summary: We construct biregular graphs with three distinct eigenvalues from semiregular group divisible designs. For every prime power $q$, we use the spectral structure of Muzychuk's Construction~A on $q+1$ copies of $\operatorname{AG}(2,q^2)$ to produce suitable group divisible designs. The resulting biregular graphs have $2q^5+q^4+q^2$ vertices and distinct eigenvalues $q^5+q^3+q^2$, $q^2$, and $-q^2$.
